patches.pr_title: fix(dsv41): align moe_swiglu_cast with DeepSeek Expert.forward BF16 rounding
patches.own_mark: Its bench_reference_alignment.py on the image, 2 boots: routed moe_swiglu_cast FP8 bytes and UE8M0 scales identical to DeepSeek's Expert.forward reference (0 diffs at TP4 inter=576 and TP3 inter=768), and the end-to-end MoE closer to the reference than 1107's; kernel time not worse beyond the interval at the decode, mid and prefill tiers. It is a precision change: the determinism gate fails by construction, so the gate checks #968 and #969 on tp4-switched-no1030.json (1107's moe.py mounted; no other patch here touches it), speed is judged on distinct prompts, and its correctness evidence is the reference alignment plus release qualification's quality evals
patches.declared_output_change: temperature-0 text changes on every shape: routed MoE activations are rounded to BF16 before MXFP8 quantization, as in DeepSeek's reference
